title: slim.json
description: Optional. Zero-config default is src/slim + gitignore-aware scan.

outDir.description: Where generated slice modules and standing tests live.

budgetMs.description: Fuzz process wall clock in milliseconds (never the fake clock). Default 30000, or 300000 if CI=1. Run returns within budgetMs+2000ms.

testCommand.description: Run after replace and during check. null = detect script 'test' in package.json, else skip.

include.description: Glob call-site roots. Default: whole repo minus gitignore and node_modules.

replacements.description: Recorded slices. Written by slim replace; slim check reads this.
